subject: Vendr portal: light-touch evidence onboarding and attestation checklist
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@vendorco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr portal: light-touch evidence onboarding and attestation checklist

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the productive call earlier. We can do a light-touch onboarding into Vendr so you don't have to re-run a full CAIQ Q/A; we typically request the following to complete Redwood's profile: 

- CAIQ snapshot (completed answers or export)
- SOC 2 summary or a redacted SOC 2 Type II (summary PDF is fine)
- Proof-of-possession for the S3 bucket / sample presign manifest (for evidence ownership)

If you can accept an invite to Vendr, we'll send a scoped upload link and a short checklist (2–3 items) so this should only take ~30–60 minutes on your side. Can you confirm: 

1) You can share a redacted SOC 2 summary (we can accept redacted reports).
2) Who should be the upload owner (name/email) so we can add them to the portal invite.
3) Any required NDAs or legal gating we should be aware of before we send an invite.

I'll cc Ben and Mina from our security intake team for technical handoff and S3 presign instructions. If you prefer, we can do a 15-minute screen-share to walk through the upload.

Appreciate it —

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com]

Attachments: vendr-onboard-checklist.pdf (stub)

Hey Jordan —

Thanks — we can do this. Quick answers: 

- We have a SOC 2 Type II but legal requires redaction before external sharing; a one-page summary or redacted PDF is fine. We can attach a summary.
- Upload owner: Rachel Patel (rachel.patel@vendorco.com)
- NDA: none required for this exchange; our security team prefers a short evidence transfer confirmation but nothing formal.

We'll accept the Vendr invite. If you can provide a presigned S3 manifest format and the portal link, Rachel will upload within 48 hours of the invite.

Attaching: VendorCo_SOC2_Summary.pdf (redacted) and caiq-snapshot-questions.xlsx (partial export).

Thanks —

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Vendr portal: light-touch evidence onboarding and attestation checklist

Jordan / Mina —

Thanks for the loop. Quick internal notes / ask list before we send the portal invite: 

- Redacted SOC2 summary is acceptable. We just need a signed cover page or confirmation in the portal metadata that the redaction was performed by VendorCo. Please ask Rachel to include that in the upload notes.
- For the proof-of-possession manifest: we prefer a small S3 presign manifest (3 sample keys + one bucket policy screenshot) instead of large archive uploads. Template: object keys, last-modified, SHA256 checksum. I'll attach a short presign example internally.
- CAIQ: partial exports are OK; we'll only map the fields marked as 'in-scope' for Redwood. If they want to hide IR-sensitive answers, they can mark them as "redacted"; we'll call out any gaps during our QA.

Action items: 
1) Jordan — send Vendr invite to rachel.patel@vendorco.com and include this checklist.
2) Mina — once uploaded, I can run a quick evidence intake and flag any missing proof (should take ~1–2 hours).

We should avoid asking for the full Type II report unless it's already public — redacted summary + presign manifest will get us to "profile complete" for initial intake.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Security Intake Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

(Attachment: presign-manifest-example.txt - internal stub)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@vendorco.com>

Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 15:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr portal: light-touch evidence onboarding and attestation checklist

Hi Liam / Rachel —

Welcome — invite sent to rachel.patel@vendorco.com via Vendr (link below). Quick checklist attached and replicated here for convenience: 

1) Upload redacted SOC 2 summary (PDF) and in the upload notes include the name/email of the person who redacted it and the date.
2) Upload CAIQ snapshot (xlsx export or CSV). Mark any answers you prefer to keep redacted with the word "REDACTED".
3) Provide a proof-of-possession manifest: 3 sample S3 object keys + bucket name + one screenshot of the bucket policy or ACL OR a short presign manifest CSV as Ben requested.

Portal link: https://vendr.example.com/onboard/abcd1234
DocuSign (for our records): DocuSign envelope: 0Z7X8Y

If you can drop the three items above into the portal by end-of-day Friday (48 hours from invite), Mina will queue the intake and Ben will QA. If anything is sensitive that needs an alternative transfer method, let us know and we can arrange a secure upload session.

Proposed short call: Fri Jun 5 10:00 AM PT (15 min) — I can set the meeting if that works for Rachel.

Thanks again — looking forward to closing this out quickly.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
